entries.title: Factions are institutions or methods of power, not nations
entries.summary: Military, Diplomats, Financiers, Intelligence, Mystics, and Inquisition represent institutions and power structures that can exist within a shared civilization.

entries.title: Use a powder-and-parchment era without literal history
entries.summary: The setting draws from late gunpowder/colonial-era material culture and institutions without becoming fantasy Europe, fantasy America, or a one-to-one historical analogue.

entries.title: Develop lore incrementally rather than writing a grand history at once
entries.summary: Lore work should proceed in small decisions and preference tests; comprehensive histories should not be invented before the underlying setting choices are approved.

entries.title: Heartland is a rules term, not the setting’s metaphysical center
entries.summary: Avoid making Heartlands the dominant lore concept. Player-facing setting and identity should center the Gauntlet and the institutional struggle.
